nom: Neutrogena Age Shield Face Oil-Free Sunscreen SPF 70

avis.texte: Doesnt blend in well with the skin. Also leaves a terrible white cast.

As a pale person I rarely struggle with white cast, but this is the worst. worse than many many mineral sunscreens I've used. It gets goofy in my eyebrows and is weirdly greasy anf matte at the same time. If I get it on my eye lids my eyes start to water and then burn. I'll use it on my neck/chest to use it up, but I don't love it. Plus, I've only had it maybe 2 months and the product has started to separate.

this does sting my eyes and I do think I'm allergic. however, it also does not blend in well on my face and leaves white dried spots on my face even after I try to blend it in. it dries white in some parts of my face yet looks greasy in other parts. however, it does work as a sunscreen but my skin definitely does not agree with whatever chemicals are in it!

Everytime i use this whether I use it when i go like on the beach or if I use it everyday or under makeup it stings my eyes. Anytime I use it my eyes start watering so extremely bad, I keep sneezing, and my nose runs extremely bad. even taking allergy medicine hasn't helped. it only happens when I use this product specifically on my face. however, it does not bother my body so I will use it on my body instead of my face.

This felt fine at first. It blended well. I dont wear foundation so I don't know how it looks/feels with it. I ran errands and by about 4 hrs in, I started getting itchy around my eyebrows and cheeks. Then about another hour in, my eyes started getting irritated. Returning. This was only my first time trying it.
If this didnt burn my eyes so bad when it happens to get in them i wouldve loved it. But not worth solely for that reason.
Feels heavy, goes in greasy but does dries matte, hard to blend in, smells strong, visible if have dark hair, leaves a white cast
Ita great on the skin, not greasy at all and it's lightweight on the skin
When I apply the sunscreen lotion my face looks and is protected by UV rays. The best sunscreen I've used.!
I love this sunscreen. I trust that it giving my face and neck adequate sun protection, it doesn't sting my eyes, and doesn't pill. Makeup applies over it perfectly.
I love this product! It is light weight, moisturizing, and has a matte finish. It doesn't run into my eyes like so many others.

I bought this because of the high SPF and age shield and it's oil free. I do not recommend because it burned my under eyes so bad and now that skin is irritated. My eyes could not stop crying, and it also stings really bad.

i like it. it protects my face really well. it leaves a white cast if you use a little too much but it's fixable. it leave a weird texture on my skin when i wash it off in the shower, but it works well so idrc
I bought this for the high SPF, but it pills up the more you try to rub it in and it REALLY stings the eyes if it gets in them. I will use this up on my arms, but wouldn't repurchase.

Why do they keep putting out these streaky messes? Who tests mineral sunscreens, sees the stripes on the face and decide it's ok to put into he market? It's kind of drying for those with dry skin too. It's frustrating.
I like it but fragrance ages your skin so therefore won't use this anymore

I bought this for daily use. Some pros are affordable, high protection and no white cast. However, my biggest issue is that it can be difficult to rub into the skin because it's very thick. I recommend using a small amount and then adding for to avoid a white cast. I will repurchase and it's a good drugstore option.

I put it on my face and it felt nice and light until I wiped my eye and got it in my eye. My eye burned for hours. It has a fragrance or smell to it and I don't like fragrance on my face or near my nose. The fragrance does tend to fade but never totally. I will probably use it for my neck, chest, arms and hands, but not on my face again near my eyes.

Ulta claims it is formulated without OXYBENZONE (a chemical that is found circulating in the bloodstream after multiple uses; already banned in Hawaii). When you go to the ingredients, it is the 4th or 5th ingredient on the list. How does this make sense?
This is a great product that goes on very smoothly, without any residue. It allows me to put my makeup on over it and acts as a great primer.

This made my neck break out in a rash that looks like a skin disease. I stopped using it immediately & it's been a few days now & still hasn't fully healed. It's super red & itchy, only on my neck. I think that's because the neck skin tends to be more sensitive. What ever is in this formula is not good for people that have sensitive skin. I'm surprised it worked for so many people. I've used a lot of products & none have done this.

avis.titre: Great coverage but not for me
avis.texte: I bought this because of the coverage. But my skin doesn't like it, it does not absorb and leaves my skin looking like is peeling off. Also around the hairline looks very white and doesn't blend in. I do like that is not as greasy and doesn't clog my pores like others have in the past, but I do not like the way it looks. Will not be buying again.

avis.titre: don't try it unless you like chemical burns
avis.texte: first of all, neutrogena removed this from their website, so now it's going on every retailer i can find. i usually use murad environmental shield with broad spectrum spf 30 but i had some of this from a year ago. i put it on my face this weekend as i was spending awhile in the sun and after a couple hours noticed my skin getting tight and itchy. i washed it off immediately and moisturized but to no avail. now, three days later, my skin is red, tight, itchy, and covered in small bumps (i used to be proud of my smooth texture - it is so rough now that it makes me sad to even apply moisturizer because i have to feel how bad it is now.) and it BURNS. i have been applying cold compresses, aloe, and tons of moisturizer to no avail and i have been crying for the past three days because it has destroyed my skin and it hurts so, so badly. i don't even have sensitive skin!! i've never had a reaction like this before - not to retinol, vit C, not even an AHA chemical peel - but this sunscreen has some extremely harsh chemicals in it that are not to be trifled with. i am praying this doesn't last too long. it hurts so bad :(
I bought the sunblock because I needed something for my face. This product is very light. It doesn't feel sticky on my face.

This is not a bad product inherently. It does what it says it will and you can always benefit from a sunscreen, especially high SPF. Unfortunately it is just heavy, thick and tough to rub in. You can't get away with applying without a mirror and it takes a minute to absorb so don't apply makeup instantly afterwards. I won't be buying it again, but it's not horrible.

avis.titre: Pills up if your wearing other skincare
avis.texte: I didn't like this product for my skin personally. It never sunk into my skin and would pill up every time I used it.

I have pale, porcelain skin and I burn very easily, so sunscreen is a must. It does not feel very greasy at all, and it sits well under my full face of makeup. Definitely my favorite drugstore sunscreen and I highly recommend it.
I have a very oily skin and I absolutely love this face sunscreen. My skin feels soft, doesn't get oily at all and I use it before putting on makeup and it lasts all day.
My dermatologist said this is what she uses - and I'd like to prevent further sun damage, so I'm trying it.
Definitely works, but it feels like you're wearing a mask. You can't wear this with makeup at all.

avis.titre: I like the way it feels on my face, and also protects it
avis.texte: I purchased this on line, as I could not find in any local store
It does not blend in or stick to your face. And if you wear glasses or sunglasses, it will leave white cake residue around your nose whenever you take them off.

I was in the sun for a long time. Applied often. No sun burn and more importantly my face isn't red or irritated. The ONLY downside is that it burns the eyes. I recommend this if you want to take care of your skin. It's made for that.
I love this product. I wanted a sunscreen that wasn't greasy so I could use it under my makeup on a daily basis. Works great, not greasy and no problem applying my makeup.
Love the product you will need a matte primer over it if you have oily or comb oily skin. I did not have any break out issues with the product. But a light hand is needed when applying.

avis.titre: too thick to wear under makeup.
avis.texte: Was looking for a good daily sunblock for my face. This one feels too thick to wear under makeup. Does apply easily , non greasy feeling.. DiWudd not buy again

avis.titre: Love it. Easy to apply. My face looks smooth, less wrinkled.
avis.texte: Use daily in the morning. My face feels refreshed once I apply it.

avis.titre: Does the job but with some compromise!!
avis.texte: This stuff definitely kept my face from burning but it irritated my skin and made my eyes sting.

avis.titre: Great so far. But I wish it went on smoother
avis.texte: Pulls on skin while applying, besides that it's not to greasy and no other issues
I use this daily under makeup and feel that I get a great product for the cost.
Was hoping for a good spf made specifically for use on the face. This was a huge disappointment. My face started itching and by the next morning it was burning and bump. Returned it immediately.

avis.titre: I'm  outside a lot, this product feels nice under my makeup.
avis.texte: This product feels nice under my makeup, I wear it everyday even in the winter.

I teach out in the sun all day in sunny so cal......it protects my facial skin from premature aging and drying out as well as from sunburn.....it does leave a white sheen/coat on my face, but that is the protective barrier.....hats help so much, but this covers the nose, face and even use it on my lips!!!!
Neutrogena products have worked well for our family. Consumer Reports rates most of them highly.

avis.titre: Guard your face from damaging rays of sun!
avis.texte: We should use this facial sun protection, on our faces and necks, every day that you plan to drive or be outdoors. This is a non-greasy product, and does a wonderful job. Always look for the key active ingredient of Avobenzone 3%, in any sunscreen.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: i have dry face after i use Neutrogena age shield face lotion my skin feel more soft and no more dryness i love it
Used this in Hawaii and San Diego and never was burnt, except the spots I missed.
Its not greasy as some of the other sun screens i have used before
Works great and would recommend for anyone to keep your face from the harmful UV rays of the sun. Was out in the hot sun for over 4 hrs and no sunburn on my face. Really protects.

I wanted a sunscreen that wouldn't clog my pores and look like heavy paste on my face and I didn't want to spend a fortune. At my age I need to be careful of sun exposure. Dark spots show up right away if I am not protected. I love this sunscreen. It is light weight, and strong. I highly recommend.
I have used this sunscreen on my face for years and it gives my skin excellent sun protection.

avis.titre: Great coverage with small amt. of produ.
avis.texte: I use the lotion daily and also apply a a foundation with sunblock.

avis.titre: Neutrogena Age Shield face sun block
avis.texte: Used product daily,and developed patches of raised rash on face and neck which was very itchy. Took me months to determine the cause.
I bought this to use on a carribean vacation and ended up loving it and now use it everyday during the summer

avis.titre: Goes on well but I was allergic
avis.texte: This product goes on well, but I had an allergic reaction and had to return it.
Within a week of using this, I developed a rash, redness of the face. My face felt numb. Be careful of this. It will cause an allergic reaction.

I use this product before Kayaking in the Florida Keys. It has a nice fragrance and rubs in easily. My only complaint is that it runs into my eyes when we have to work hard against the tropical wind. I learned to keep it above my eyebrows!
I apply it after allowing my moisturizer to absorb for a minute or two. Don't get it too close to eyes or it will sting. I know it helps prevent age spots.
I love this product! It combines anti-aging and has helioplex for maximum full spectrum sun protection.

I use Retina but still enjoy being outside. This sunscreen has been the most effective in protecting my face out of all the other products I've tried this summer. I run for hours and haven't had any problems with my eyes stinging with this sunscreen.

It covered my skin OK, however, it stung my eyes and after it dried it started rubbing off. My face looked like I dipped it in flour. I also ended up with angry, itchy rash on my face and neck, had to use prescription cortisone cream for 3 days to get rid of it, and my skin isn't even sensitive.

avis.auteur: Jamie with the fair, picky skin type
avis.texte: If you are sun sensitive (or not) and skin sensitive (or not), this is the best screen I've found for offshore or all-day beach protection.

avis.titre: great sun block in captiva, florida sun
avis.texte: I just celebrated my 64th birthday and spent 7 days in the sun on Captiva Island, FL. I needed a product that would keep the skin on my face and body from breaking out, burning and wrinkling. This product worked beautifully in some strong, hot sun. I believe I have found the answer to being in the sun and not worrying about skin cancer.
I use this product everyday instead of moisturizer. I have used it for 6 weeks or so, and it has really worked. No more age spots!

My job is outdoors, so I'm in the sun all day long. This stuff really protects my skin. I never get burned! I have oily, acne-prone skin and this doesn't make me break out at all. It sinks into skin really easily and I love the fact that it has antioxidants in it. This is the first facial sunscreen that I've used where I am able to apply it around the eye area and it doesn't burn. The only problem I have is with the smell, which is too strong.

avis.titre: Have used it in the past. Works well!
avis.texte: Works great, be sure to not apply a large amount as it will not absorb and will leave white spots.

I wanted this product to apply under my makeup to product my face from daily sun exposure and its aging effects. I tried on 3 different days with 3 different foundations to wear this product, but in all three cases the sunscreen beaded up under the makeup. I would ONLY recommend this product to be worn without foundation at the pool or beach or for playing a sport.
I used this product liberally while working in the yard on a sunny, hot day. It works great, but left my skin pink and itchy. The irritation went away over night.
Must be careful that product is absorbed evenly or you will get white streaks/areas.
Product work for being out there 8 hours in the sun within even reapplying it. It went on nice and you didn't have to run in to hard.
Use product everyday as morning moisturizer under makeup. Absorbed into skin with no greasy or sticky feel.
Applies very evenly, doesn't sweat off even with a strenuous workout. Feels like an expensive primer.
After use this sunblock, my sensitive skin didn't turn red or tan. It do protection and keep moisture very well.
